expectations.evidence: The transcript never mentions a ~70% figure. The only percentages are customer-region splits (~40%, ~15%, ~45%), the ~10%/~100% change rates in the model and a 2% guardrail threshold. Nothing is attributed to Snowflake as a vendor-published claim or discounted for coming from the vendor. The only number sourced to Snowflake is the $20/TB transfer rate, which the transcript gives 'as I recall it' and says to check against the rate card. That is not the ~70% figure.
